Benefit-risk scores and win statistics of simulated trials

Source: R/SimSelection.R
SimSelection.Rd

For each simulated trial, compares a treatment cohort with a control cohort by the posterior benefit-risk score against target values (both cohorts), optionally by the benefit-risk score of the treatment cohort relative to the control cohort, and by generalized pairwise comparisons. The results are summarized by SelectionOC and CalibrateThreshold.

Usage

SimSelection(
  data,
  endpoints,
  criteria,
  treatment,
  control,
  criteria.ref = NULL,
  priority = NULL,
  threshold = NULL,
  group = "group",
  sim = "sim",
  conf.level = 0.95,
  n.nodes = 200,
  scores = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

Patient-level data of many simulated trials, for example from SimCohorts.

endpoints

An Endpoint object or a list of them.

criteria

Data frame of the components of the benefit-risk score against target values; see BenefitRisk.

treatment, control

Names of the two cohorts compared.

criteria.ref

Optional data frame of the components of the benefit-risk score of treatment relative to control.

priority, threshold

Priority order and thresholds of the pairwise comparisons; see WinStat.

group, sim

Names of the columns of data with the cohort and the simulated trial.

conf.level

Confidence level of the lower bound of the net treatment benefit.

n.nodes

Number of Gauss-Legendre nodes for probabilities of differences.

scores

Logical: if TRUE, the posterior probabilities of the components are added to the output.

Value

A data frame with one row per simulated trial. With scores = TRUE, the posterior probabilities of the components are added after the columns below, in columns named trt:, ctl: and ref: followed by the label of the component. The columns are

sim

The simulated trial.

br_trt, br_ctl

Benefit-risk scores against target values.

adm_trt, adm_ctl

Admissibility against target values.

br_diff

br_trt - br_ctl.

br_ref, adm_ref

Benefit-risk score and admissibility of the treatment cohort relative to the control cohort (only with criteria.ref).

p_win, p_loss, p_tie, ntb, ntb_se, ntb_lower, wr, wo

Proportions of pairs won, lost and tied, net treatment benefit with its standard error and lower confidence bound, win ratio and win odds.

Details

The benefit-risk scores are computed as in BenefitRisk, with criteria for the scores against target values and criteria.ref for the score relative to the control cohort. The win statistics are computed as in WinStat. Every simulated trial must contain patients of both cohorts.

See also

SelectionOC, CalibrateThreshold

Examples

arms <- list(
  Cohort1 = CorOncoEndpoints::OncoArm(pfs.median = 8, orr = 0.45, resp.cor = 0.4,
                                      death.prop = 0.15, os.median = 18),
  Cohort2 = CorOncoEndpoints::OncoArm(pfs.median = 6, orr = 0.30, resp.cor = 0.4,
                                      death.prop = 0.15, os.median = 15))
d <- SimCohorts(nsim = 20, n = c(40, 40), arms = arms, ae.rate = c(0.35, 0.20),
                cutoff = 24, a.time = c(0, 12), seed = 1)
eps <- list(Endpoint("OS", "tte", time = "os_tte", event = "os_event"),
            Endpoint("PFS", "tte", time = "pfs_tte", event = "pfs_event"),
            Endpoint("ORR", "binary", var = "response"),
            Endpoint("AE", "binary", var = "ae", higher.better = FALSE))
crit <- data.frame(endpoint = c("ORR", "PFS", "AE"), target = c(0.3, 0.5, 0.3),
                   time = c(NA, 6, NA))
crit_ref <- data.frame(endpoint = c("ORR", "PFS", "AE"),
                       measure = c("rate", "hr", "rate"),
                       target = c(0.1, 0.8, 0.1))
res <- SimSelection(d, eps, crit, treatment = "Cohort1", control = "Cohort2",
                    criteria.ref = crit_ref)
head(res)
